items.english: This is my mother.
This is my father.
My grandmother lives near us.
My grandfather drinks coffee in the morning.
I have a brother and a sister.

items.maltese: It-tifel huwa żgħir u t-tifla hija ferħana.
items.english: The boy is small and the girl is happy.
My parents are at home.
We have a big family.
I live in a house.
My house is big.
There is a big window in the kitchen.
I have a small garden.
The kitchen is clean.
My bedroom is small.
There is a bed in the bedroom.
The living room is comfortable.
There is a table in the kitchen.
There are four chairs in the living room.
The sofa is in front of the TV.
The bed is in the bedroom.
The fridge is in the kitchen.
The lamp is near the bed.
There is a big shelf in the room.
I have a small desk at home.
I like bread and cheese.
I eat an egg in the morning.
We eat a lot of vegetables.

items.maltese: Hemm ross u tiġieġ fuq il-mejda.
items.english: There is rice and chicken on the table.
My sister likes salad and fruit.
Sometimes I eat pizza in the evening.
My father likes fish.
My mother makes good soup.
I drink water.
In the morning I have coffee.
In the evening I drink tea.
I like cold juice.
The boy drinks milk.
I do not drink a lot of coffee.
My mother likes hot tea.
My father drinks cold water.
I like pizza.
I do not like tea.
I like eating with the family.
I do not like eating late.

items.maltese: Il-familja tiegħi hija żgħira. Għandi omm, missier u ħu. Aħna noqogħdu f'dar kbira.
items.english: My family is small. I have a mother, a father and a brother. We live in a big house.

items.maltese: Id-dar tiegħi għandha kċina, salott u kamra tas-sodda. Hemm mejda fil-kċina u saqqu fil-kamra tas-sodda.
items.english: My house has a kitchen, a living room and a bedroom. There is a table in the kitchen and a bed in the bedroom.

items.maltese: Inħobb il-frott, il-ħobż u l-ġobon. Filgħodu nieħu kafè u niekol bajda.
items.english: I like fruit, bread and cheese. In the morning I have coffee and eat an egg.

items.maltese: Ma nħobbx ħafna te, imma nħobb ilma u meraq.
items.english: I do not like tea very much, but I like water and juice.

items.maltese: Jien inħobb niekol mal-familja tiegħi d-dar.
items.english: I like eating with my family at home.
